description:
## 1.8.0-dev.3 (2026-11-26)

- **BoldVoice:** Complete the local PairIP license state on 5.3.6 build 499 (ARM64 APKS). Void the remaining license, paywall, and error entry points the VM program can reach directly (checkLicenseInternal, startPaywallActivity, handleError), force the installer and local-check predicates to report success, and start LicenseClient at FULL_CHECK_OK so sideloaded installs no longer reach the "get this app from Play Store" screen. PairIP VM remains active for hoisted strings until full devirtualization assets land; the 5.1.3 build 470 devirtualization path is unchanged.
